test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'QUANTITY' is written as 'TPMZHSXS', 'RELIABLE' is written as 'DQHKAZDK'. How will 'SAMPLING' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f55d12914eebca7e2ddb78639b4fc871fb7d8ad27dd3a27d7a12202515a267d.png] 

**Logic: **Subtraction of (1) from the all alphabet position value and written diagonally.

'QUANTITY' is written as 'TPMZHSXS' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efee4bad517ecd22adc30318d903c272bc68f991c8622b1a990fe5421a4eed59.png] 

'RELIABLE' is written as 'DQHKAZDK' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d58df2771581887701541d7d858c4c1c50d5220cb0369056a0c4320b28a8b19.png] 

Similarly, 'SAMPLING' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/199d1f035742eb3ddaacfd417b9ca6ff52752ae63284622417cbb75d33db722e.png] 

Here, 'SAMPLING' is written as **'ZROLHKFM'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
